newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP shares firm on 1st qtr profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP shares firm on 1st qtr profit.

text.p: Shares in The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd edged slightly higher on Friday after the recently battered blue chip posted a first quarter net profit of A$287 million and pointed to some signs of an improving domestic steel market.
The stock was trading at 12.45 p.m. (0245 GMT) at A$16.09, up six cents on its level before the profit announcement at 0219 GMT, but steady with Thursday's close.
Brokers said the result was at the lower to mid-range of market expectations and that trading in the stock was light, dominated by small orders from mainly private clients.
"Maybe investors are buying up, but not too much," a Melbourne-based broker told Reuters.
"Now I think it's almost the same as at the time of the announcement, so there's still no direction for BHP."
BHP's share price has fallen heavily in recent weeks on downgrades to independent profit forecasts and concerns about weakness in the steel market and in the copper price.
BHP is Australia's only producer of raw steel and is the world's second largest producer of copper.
BHP shares were two cents lower at A$16.07 at 1.50 p.m. (0350 GMT).
